description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) related to coupon functionality in the Kotlin frontend network module, including request and response models for applying and validating coupons.

classes.name: CouponApplyRequestDto
classes.description: DTO for requesting the application of a coupon code.

classes.name: CouponDto
classes.description: DTO representing a coupon, including details like code, description, discount type, amount, minimum subtotal, and expiry date.

classes.name: CouponValidationResponseDto
classes.description: DTO for the response to a coupon validation request, indicating validity, message, and coupon details.
